title: National Rail Museum, New Delhi
geometryBasis: The native museum boundary contains the exact octagonal indoor gallery footprint, Rail Cafeteria and four service buildings. Four approximate canopy spans sit over native sidings. The track network and native turntable ring and center locate the surviving outdoor gallery and turntable.
sectionBasis: Five exact Qualla CC0 photos establish open-sided, curved corrugated roofs, metal supports, rail ballast and adjacent paved strips. The National Rail Museum and Ministry of Culture identify the indoor and outdoor galleries and the turntable. Building cross sections, exact canopy dimensions and the fixed bridge are estimated.
limitations: The Indoor Gallery, Rail Cafeteria and fixed yard buildings follow the mapped footprints. Their external finishes, roof sections and door positions are approximate.
Open-sided steel canopies follow the October 2023 Qualla originals. Individual canopy dimensions, their exact extents along the chosen four sidings, and the turntable bridge are estimates.

The original elevation field controls the terrain and track grade. India’s common 1.676 m broad gauge and a two-foot visitor-track gauge are approximations for the museum alignments. The track bend radii and turnout hardware are generalized.
The structures represent the preserved railway yard in 2023. Rolling stock, station exhibits, gardens and interiors are outside this model.

additionalWrittenContext.facts: The 2026 redevelopment proposal describes the existing turntable and separately proposes moving it to a central position. The model retains the documented pre-redevelopment layout.
